Package org.us_ignite.thingworx.jgit.extension

Class PastedKeyGpgSigner

java.lang.Object
org.us_ignite.thingworx.jgit.extension.PastedKeyGpgSigner
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.eclipse.jgit.lib.Signer
public class PastedKeyGpgSigner extends Object implements org.eclipse.jgit.lib.Signer
JGit signer that reads an ASCII-armored private key supplied by the ThingWorx user.

The key is held only in memory and can be explicitly cleared after signing. This class never writes the private key to the repository or to a file.
